combinedLogCoverage.timeSemantics: Loguru local UTC hh:mm:ss A, date bounded by nearby structured Unix timestamps. Uvicorn access lines lack timestamps; their preceding Loguru timestamp is an approximate lower bound.

limitations: Stable proxy disables access logging, so its individual connection/timeout/cancel outcomes are not persisted.
Model middleware records failures and selected recovery stages; it does not record successful request arrival/completion or queue wait times.
Loguru model activity lacks per-request ID and release/PID, so concurrent blue/green attribution is not exact.
Current process state and source identity corroborate continuity but are not historical GPU utilization measurements.
